value.rationale: The family models a marked rare target competing with long internal trap excursions and quick decoy-leaf excursions. An exact load boundary for whether resetting helps, a topology-invariant all-time hitting law, and the optimal rare-target exponential scaling provide complete structural search-design information unavailable from an unspecified general spectral formula. The precise pendant load is motivated as the number of fast false-target opportunities; it is not an arbitrarily chosen numeric slice.
